highway-traffic: Highway Traffic is a 3D driving simulation game where players steer vehicles through dense freeway congestion. You weave between lanes at high speeds, aiming to travel as far as possible without crashing into other cars.
Dogeminer2: Dogeminer 2 is an idle incremental clicker game starring the internet's favorite Shiba Inu. Players mine planetary rock, hire shibe helpers, and buy rocket ships to travel across the galaxy to reach the moon.
scary-shawarma-kiosk-the-anomaly: Scary Shawarma Kiosk: The Anomaly is an atmospheric first-person horror simulator. Players prepare late-night street food orders while surviving paranormal occurrences and anomalous customers stalking their kiosk.
cave-story: Cave Story is an acclaimed Metroidvania side-scrolling platformer following an amnesiac robot named Quote. Players explore sprawling subterranean caverns, upgrade unique firearms, and fight bosses to save the rabbit-like Mimigas.
highway-racer: Highway Racer is a fast-paced 3D arcade driving game focused on reckless high-speed overtaking. Players maneuver down packed highways, earning money for near misses and using rewards to customize or upgrade performance cars.
highway-racer-2: Highway Racer 2 is an upgraded 3D traffic-dodging racing game with enhanced vehicle handling and graphics. Players race through dynamic weather conditions and dense traffic, dodging collisions to unlock high-tier supercars.
earn-to-die-2: Earn to Die 2 is a 2D vehicle-upgrading physics platformer set during a zombie apocalypse. Players plow through hordes of the undead, upgrading armor, fuel, and weapons to reach an evacuation ship.
adventure-drivers: Adventure Drivers is a side-scrolling 2D stunt racing game set on tropical island tracks. Players perform mid-air flips to generate nitro boosts, collect coins, and fire weapons to cross the finish line first.
escape-road-city-2: Escape Road City 2 is a high-speed vehicle evasion game where players flee from pursuing police cruisers. You drift around sharp city corners, weave through urban obstacles, and avoid roadblocks to keep the chase alive.
deltarune: Deltarune is an episodic turn-based role-playing game created by Toby Fox. Players control human teenager Kris alongside monster classmates, solving puzzles and sparing eccentric enemies through bullet-hell combat encounters in the Dark World.
gravity-soccer: Gravity Soccer is a physics-based sports puzzle game that challenges your problem-solving skills. Players destroy destructible blocks and manipulate gravity to guide soccer balls into the net while collecting bonus stars.
getting-over-it-with-bennett-foddy: Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy is a notoriously punishing physics game about a man in a cauldron. Players use mouse movements to swing a sledgehammer, slowly climbing a mountain of junk while battling devastating falls.
sandspiel: Sandspiel is an interactive cellular automata sandbox game featuring falling elements. Players paint with elements like sand, water, acid, and fire to trigger complex physical and chemical simulations in real time.
stealingthediamond: Stealing the Diamond is a humorous point-and-click adventure game starring Henry Stickmin. Players choose between absurd gadget options and risky plans to pull off an audacious museum heist without getting caught.
canyondefense: Canyon Defense is a tactical tower defense game set in a rugged desert canyon. Players position missile batteries, laser turrets, and anti-air guns along the canyon paths to eliminate incoming waves of military invaders.
impossiblequiz: The Impossible Quiz is a classic, hilarious puzzle game packed with baffling brain teasers and lateral-thinking riddles. Players click or solve each question using unpredictable logic, attempting to beat every level before running out of lives.
